Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
feat(Echo): Add telemetry event for scheduler startup

Introduce telemetry capture for `land:echo:scheduler:start` within `SchedulerBuilder::Build` to track worker pool initialization. This requires adding the `Common` crate as a dependency in `Cargo.toml` to access the `Telemetry::CaptureEvent` function.

This change enables the Boot dashboard to monitor the active worker-pool size across processes utilizing Echo (e.g., Mountain), providing visibility into resource allocation at runtime. The telemetry event is emitted only when the `Capture` flag is enabled, remaining a no-op in release builds.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
chore(Echo): Standardize CHANGELOG formatting and whitespace

Refactor the CHANGELOG.md file to remove legacy line-break artifacts and ensure consistent line wrapping across all version history entries. The diff shows a reformatting of the entire document to align with standard markdown presentation while preserving the narrative of Echo's evolution from a Cloudflare Workers scaffold to the high-performance Rust work-stealing scheduler.

This cleanup ensures the documentation remains readable and consistent with the project's strict formatting standards, facilitating better maintainability as the version history grows.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
docs(Echo): Expand CHANGELOG with comprehensive version history

Replace the sparse version history (0.0.1 through 0.6.0) with a complete changelog documenting all releases from v0.1 (Q3 2024) through v2.0 (Q1 2026). The expanded changelog captures the full evolution of the Echo task scheduler: the initial Sequence-based architecture, the pivotal June 2025 flip to the work-stealing Scheduler design, Cloudflare Workers integration, PascalCase enforcement, and the current stable v2.0 architecture.

Adheres to Keep a Changelog format with clear Added/Changed/Removed sections for each release.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
docs(Echo): Expand CHANGELOG with comprehensive version history

Replace the minimal placeholder CHANGELOG (only "Initial version") with a complete version history documenting releases from 0.6.0 (2026 Q2) back to 0.0.1 (2024 Q3).

The changelog now captures all notable changes including work-stealing scheduler optimizations, Cloudflare Workers integration updates, dependency upgrades, CI improvements, and licensing changes.

This provides better visibility into the Echo element's evolution and adheres to Keep a Changelog format.
